reset.action: cold pointer click of dimmed Reset

state.description: More than one connection uses the ID "e1", so the editor cannot tell which one you mean. To repair it, remove a Decision route one of them starts from (its review should list just that connection), add the route back and draw its connection again, until one keeps the ID. Otherwise, or without a pointer, correct the ID with PUT /loops/{id}/draft.

refusals: Connection refused: More than one connection uses the ID "e1", so the editor cannot tell which one you mean. To repair it, remove a Decision route one of them starts from (its review should list just that connection), add the route back and draw its connection again, until one keeps the ID. Otherwise, or without a pointer, correct the ID with PUT /loops/{id}/draft.
